statement: R3-P C-lite: candidate need relations generated by PEE from its own knowledge (scripts/r3p-need-candidates.mjs, 2026-10-20). Every rule is experimental: evaluated only in shadow, never deciding. Not written by hand; not reviewed.

vocabulary.name: req_category
vocabulary.meaning: the category the request was resolved to

vocabulary.name: req_context
vocabulary.meaning: a QK use context the request names, not negated

vocabulary.name: req_word
vocabulary.meaning: a content word stem of the request, not set aside

vocabulary.name: candidate_need
vocabulary.meaning: an outcome a candidate rule would add (shadow)
